title: Phoenix, AZ — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

Overview

Phoenix is a city in AZ with a population of 1,644,409. Valley of the Sun with 300+ days of sunshine, affordable housing, and rapid growth. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 299 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.8.
